notes.title: Small update - Replayability
notes.notes:
The major change is that if you have already completed the game and click "continue," you will be back in the Throne room, and can use shortcuts to traverse the game. 
Even if you start a new game after finishing, as long as you have the “End Game” Steam achievement, you can traverse the game using shortcuts.

[h3][b]Shortcuts are:[/b][/h3]
- Left ctrl + F: fill the correct code for that puzzle. For input-based puzzles, fill the correct input.
- Left ctrl + ‘+’ : next level
- Left ctrl + ‘-’ : previous level
[b]Note:[/b] Going through levels using the shortcuts will not save, and will put you at the start/beginning of the level even if you have solved it.
- Left shift + ‘1’:  add 1 key
- Left alt  + ‘1’: remove 1 key
- Left ctrl + ‘T’: spawn the cat if you don’t have it yet.
[b]Note: [/b]the shortcuts were mainly for me to be able to playtest, so they might not always be perfect.
[b]Note:[/b] the shortcuts should not work if you haven’t already finished the game.

[h3][b]Other small fixes:[/b][/h3]
Sometimes the coding interfaces with input have the wrong code that is not modifiable, that should be fixed. (or at least one path for that bug is fixed, not sure if there are more)
Small fixes with while loop levels. These should not say there is an infinite loop when there shouldn’t be.
Fix for the 3rd manuscript not showing in the inventory.

notes.title: Small Update July 6th
notes.notes:
- Mainly fixing level loadings becoming very long/slow after reaching the Micros Training center. If you have experienced that, the first relaunch of the game will be slow but things should get smoother after that. Hopefully, you don't lose your save data. 

- Tried to fix some issues with falling through in some levels, but that could probably still happen, if it does, use ctrl + R to reset the player's position.

- The game works best at 16:9 aspect ratio, if you are using another ratio, I tried to make things mostly visible (not always pretty) and haven't tested all levels, so should be playable but no guarantees.

notes.title: Patch notes July 4th
notes.notes:
- Fixed some issues with some level transitions where the player falls indefinitely.
- If you happen to encounter any falls, you can press ctrl+R to reset the player position to the beginning of the level.
- Removed a pop-up that leads to an old survey.
- Fixed some issues with "new game" not properly erasing the save data.
- Fixed an issue with the last door not opening properly if the player closes the game after saving the king and queen, and leaves. Unfortunately for this one, you would have to go back and "resave" the king and queen for the door to properly open.
